signal: Multiple operating modules require the same ingestion, normalization, reconciliation, alerting, and approval capabilities.
evidence: Run 006 subscription operations already uses multi-source evidence, deterministic reconciliation, owner alerts, and governed execution.
Proposed inbox, bills, follow-up, documents, security, and warranty modules repeat the same control pattern.
whyItMatters: Building each module independently would duplicate infrastructure and increase maintenance and policy drift.
proposedCapability: Shared Personal & Business Operations Core: source registry, evidence envelope, reconciliation engine, exception queue, notification service, authority gateway, audit log.
recommendedNextAction: Architect the shared core before building the seven proposed modules separately.

signal: Owner repeatedly depends on remembering pending replies, future actions, approvals, and deferred tasks across projects.
evidence: Subscription Operations contains deferred G6 actions and later account additions.
Multiple projects use Resume Here and manual reminders to preserve continuity.
whyItMatters: Untracked waiting states create silent stalls and cognitive load.

recommendedNextAction: Include as an early module after shared infrastructure.

signal: Notification logic is appearing in multiple systems.
